data.name: Drug Resistance
data.description: When you ingest drugs, you take half as much ability damage (minimum 1). You also gain a +4 bonus on saving throws to avoid becoming addicted to a drug or to overcome being addicted (Pathfinder RPG GameMastery Guide 236).
